blurb: East Coast Varsity provides a private school with programs from Pre-Primary to Middle School focusing on academic, physical, and social enrichment. They offer facility rentals including a turf dome and hockey rink for local sports organizations. Their after school programs and multi-sport camps include a variety of activities such as sports, arts, crafts, and field trips.
